crossRefs.note: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
“Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
Look at this. We have searched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
“Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
“I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
(which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…

translations.web: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
translations.bsb: “Indeed, my eyes have seen all this; my ears have heard and understood.
translations.kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood
translations.asv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, Mine ear hath heard and understood it.
